_comment: TPS Report Generator OPERATING PROCEDURE -- LOCKED spec-data (CLAUDE.md Rule 8).
deterministic, gated, played completely straight; documented in the TPS Report
Generator manual). TPSREP.COM (os/milton/tpsrep_program.asm) enforces these rows
in order, before anything is printed. Every literal below appears verbatim in
the program (lint: make test-tps-report, leg [spec]); '{n}' marks a value the
program fills in. All wording is ASCII and upper case, as on the period terminal.
Changing a row is a deliberate act with an issue + worklog note, never a silent
edit to make a gate pass.

rows.name: mandatory parameter file
rows.rule: TPSPARM.DAT must open through FCB AH=0Fh in the current directory and supply TITLE=, DIVISION=, MEMO= and LINES=.
refuse: TPS-001 PARAMETER FILE TPSPARM.DAT NOT FOUND.
REFER TO OPERATING PROCEDURE OP-7.3 (PARAMETER FILES).
refuse_missing_key: REFER TO OPERATING PROCEDURE OP-7.3 (PARAMETER FILES).

rows.name: form feed alignment
rows.rule: The SPACE BAR must be pressed EXACTLY 7 times, then ENTER. Any other count restarts the count with a message; other keys are ignored. Each press is acknowledged with a period.
prompt: PRESS THE SPACE BAR EXACTLY 7 TIMES TO ALIGN THE FORM FEED,
refuse: FORM NOT ALIGNED ({n} PRESSES). THE COUNT HAS BEEN RESET.

rows.name: report number keyed twice
rows.rule: The TPS report number (1 to 6 digits) is keyed, then keyed again; the two must agree or both are asked for again.
refuse: TPS-003 REPORT NUMBERS DO NOT AGREE. PLEASE BEGIN AGAIN.

rows.name: memo acknowledgement
rows.rule: The operator confirms reading the memo about the new cover sheets by keying its number, which must equal the MEMO= parameter; otherwise asked again.
prompt: KEY THE NUMBER OF THE MEMO ABOUT THE NEW COVER SHEETS:
refuse: TPS-004 THAT IS NOT THE MEMO NUMBER. SEE YOUR SUPERVISOR.

rows.name: cover sheet attestation
rows.rule: Y continues to the report. N ends the run with return code 5 and no report file. Other keys are ignored.
prompt: DID YOU REMEMBER TO ATTACH THE NEW COVER SHEET? (Y/N)
refuse: TPS-005 REPORT NOT PRINTED. A COPY OF MEMO {n} WILL BE

errors.rule: The table must be a dBASE III table carrying RPT_NO, EMPLOYEE, DEPT, PAGES, COVER and FILED.
refuse: TPS-006 TABLE IS NOT A TPS TABLE (FIELD {n} NOT FOUND).

errors.rule: A table must be named on the command line and open through FCB AH=0Fh.
TPSREPT.TXT must be creatable through FCB AH=16h.
refuse: TPS-008 TPSREPT.TXT COULD NOT BE CREATED.

file_rules: The table named on the command line is read through FCB AH=0Fh/21h (128-byte random records).
Before the report is written, TPSREPT.BAK is deleted (AH=13h) and an existing TPSREPT.TXT is renamed TPSREPT.BAK (AH=17h).
TPSREPT.TXT is created with AH=16h and written with AH=15h in 128-byte records; the last record is padded with Ctrl-Z (1Ah).
The cover sheet lists every .DBF in the current directory (AH=11h/12h).
end_line: TPS REPORT GENERATOR TERMINATED. RETURN CODE {n}.
